summary: Flutter administration now has the web AdminMediaDiagnostics tab. It reads the authenticated, administrator-protected anonymous /admin/screen-metrics contract, validates bounded fixed-enum samples, displays recent sender/receiver dimensions and media/network metrics, and refreshes every five seconds only while the tab is selected and the app is foregrounded.

checks.name: Admin screen metrics API contract
checks.observation: The client requests /api/v1/admin/screen-metrics with the session cookie and no-store cache policy, parses valid receiver dimensions/FPS/bitrate/RTT, and rejects malformed or excessive samples.

checks.name: Media tab widget behavior
checks.observation: Covers empty and populated states, 390 dp mobile width, periodic refresh, stopping refresh after leaving the tab, generic accessible error copy, and retry.

checks.name: Android debug build
checks.observation: Built the Android debug APK. Existing Kotlin Gradle Plugin migration warning for flutter_background, flutter_webrtc and livekit_client remains.

checks.name: Windows runner validation
checks.observation: Push this desktop change to run the GitVerse Flutter Windows CI workflow on boohtacord-windows; tests, analyzer and Windows Release compilation must pass before closing this point.

checks.name: Live admin ACL and screenshot comparison
checks.observation: Widget tests verify behavior and narrow layout. Administrator/member REST ACL and matched screenshots across macOS, Windows and Android remain to be accepted against the live backend.

remaining: Verify the GitVerse Windows runner after push, then validate the administrator-only endpoint with the live service and compare the four-tab panel visually against web on macOS, Windows and Android.
